{{Quote|They say I'm the worst kind of pirate, ambushing unarmed ships to steal their cargoes. I say that's the best kind of pirate.|Kath Scarlet|<ref name="Card">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Kath Scarlet}}</ref>}}
This [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|'''''Firespray-31''-class''']] '''patrol and attack craft''' was flown by [[Kath Scarlet]], the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Binayre Pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Scarlet used the ship to ambush and capture the cargo of unarmed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] passing through [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. When an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was dispatched on a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to find and destroy a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], Scarlet&mdash;thinking it was a cargo ship&mdash;used her Firespray to disable and board the vessel as it exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] but was repelled and forced to escape.

==History==
[[File:Pirate_Trap_SOC.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Scarlet's Firespray ambushing a lone Z-95 Headhunter]]
{{Quote|Permission to come aboard? Oh never mind, I'm already here. I'm Kath Scarlet, captain of the Binayre pirates, and I don't like trouble. Surrender and take me to your cargo hold. Or die. Up to you.|Kath Scarlet|<ref name="SOC-PT" />}}
Before and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Kath Scarlet]] would hide her Firespray-31 among asteroids and ambush unarmed [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] vessels, capturing any unwary [[Starship/Legends|starships]] passing through [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian sector/Legends|sector]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] under the control of the [[Binayre Pirates]]&mdash;a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] based out of the [[Double Worlds|twin worlds]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]].

During the Galactic Civil War, Scarlet's Firespray was nearby when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] on a mission to seek out and destroy a secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on Talus. Believing the arriving [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to be a cargo vessel, Scarlet attacked with her Firespray, using her ship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] to target the shuttle's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], disabling it and preventing the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] from escaping. Once the shuttle was disabled, Scarlet used the Firespray's [[grappler]]s to secure the shuttle to her ship in order to board it with her pirate crew. However, the Imperial forces were able to repel the pirates, forcing Scarlet to escape in her Firespray before the Imperials could give chase.<ref name="SOC-PT" />
